name: Strategy-Level Risk Parity Ensemble
description: Meta-portfolio blending 5 diverse validated sub-strategies using inverse-volatility weighting (Qian 2005 risk parity applied across strategies). Each sub-strategy weighted by 1/trailing_volatility (504d = 24-month lookback), normalized to sum 1.0. Produces more balanced ensemble risk contribution than naive equal-weight blending. Targets modest Sharpe uplift (+0.05-0.15) and reduced volatility clustering.
